claims.hypothesis: The mass of the most massive cluster in a cloud scales with cloud properties
claims.experiment: match HST clusters to ALMA CO clouds, fit log-log relations
claims.result: clear positive correlations of M_cluster,max with M_cloud, column density, SFR and SFR surface density
claims.finding: M_cluster,max is positively related to cloud mass, column density, SFR and SFR surface density

evidence.quote: The mass of the most massive cluster ($M_{\rm cluster, max}$) in a cloud is positively proportional to the mass ($M_{\rm cloud}$), the column density, the SFR sand the SFR surface density of the cloud.

claims.hypothesis: Typical cloud-scale SFE across the five galaxies
claims.experiment: divide total stellar mass (clusters plus associations) by cloud mass plus stellar mass
claims.finding: cloud-scale SFE about 1.4%, with a trend of lower SFE in more massive clouds

evidence.quote: we obtained a typical value of the cloud-scale star formation efficiency (SFE), $\approx$1.4%

claims.hypothesis: The ICIMF theory explains the M_cluster,max-M_cloud relation
claims.experiment: model with optimal sampling, SFE = 1.4%, free beta, compared with observed relation
claims.result: model fits reasonably; smaller beta fits better; higher SFE fits low-mass clouds better
claims.finding: ICIMF provides a quantitative framework, but only a rough fit with the same parameters for all clouds

evidence.quote: We constructed an integrated cloud-wide IMF (ICIMF) model that provides a good fit to the observed $M_{\rm cluster, max}$-$M_{\rm cloud}$ relation.
Therefore, using the same parameter settings for all molecular clouds can only result in a rough fit.

claims.hypothesis: Embedded phase duration relative to the exposed population
claims.experiment: compare 21 micron-derived embedded masses with HST masses
claims.result: embedded masses systematically smaller than HST-observed masses
claims.finding: short duration of the embedded phase

evidence.quote: This suggests a short duration of the embedded phase.

why_this_data.value: high-resolution ALMA CO, JWST and HST allow connecting individual clouds with their stellar populations

evidence.quote: The combination of these high-resolution observations provides an unprecedented look at the connection between individual clouds and the stellar populations

why_this_method.value: strictly masked Moment 0 maps chosen for reliable structures; minimal dendrogram parameters to reduce dependence on settings

evidence.quote: We do not set additional parameters in the algorithm to minimize the dependence of the identification on parameter settings.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: broadly masked Moment 0 maps rejected as noisier with possible false positives

evidence.quote: they tend to be noisier and may contain false positives

limitations_admitted.value: unified alpha_CO for all galaxies; per-cloud correction left for future work

evidence.quote: it is important to correct $\alpha^{2-1}_{\rm CO}$ for each molecular cloud to accurately estimate the mass of the cloud. This will be left for future work.

limitations_admitted.value: same SFE and beta used for all clouds gives only a rough fit

evidence.quote: using the same parameter settings for all molecular clouds can only result in a rough fit.

limitations_admitted.value: embedded populations may not be observed in PHANGS-HST

evidence.quote: The embedded stellar populations in molecular clouds may not be observed in the PHANGS-HST survey

referee_caveats_inferred: Correlation r values are modest (0.35-0.71) and fit method/uncertainty treatment is not described
Cloud scale is about 70-120 pc, so structures are blends of clouds and complexes rather than single GMCs
Embedded phase duration of 5.1 Myr from NGC 628 is applied to other galaxies without testing
Cluster-to-cloud matching by centre distance within R_eff can mis-assign projected clusters
Model comparison to data is qualitative; no statistical fit of beta and SFE

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Moderate (tens of GB): public PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) cubes/moment maps and PHANGS-JWST F2100W maps for five galaxies plus HST catalogs; only Moment 0 maps strictly needed for identification
reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and the main steps are described, but fit methods, t_age derivation, and several inherited settings are in earlier papers or not stated; key results are mostly in figures and a correlation table.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Data are public, but the recipe relies on earlier papers and omits fitting details, so the main numbers cannot be redone from this paper alone.
